task: [Автозадача из бэклога] `tools/test-driver-loop-strictmode.ps1` — dot-source блоков 83/85/86 под `Set-StrictMode -Version Latest` на (i) неполном `$turnResult`, (ii) fresh-process unset `$plannerStatus`/`$fastLaneDone`/`$modeBeforeIncrement`; assert «нет throw» И «action-evidence guard оценивается против ТЕКУЩЕГО turn, не stale»; добавить в `smoke.ps1` · триггерится в smoke/CI · метрика: регресс-покрытие обоих механизмов — класс не воскреснет от будущего StrictMode-leak (`audit-security.ps1:1` и пр. чистить НЕ надо) · риск: тест должен мокать `Read-State`/`Update-State` для изоляции — аккуратный стаб
goal: To add a new regression test to `smoke.ps1` that verifies the robustness of blocks 83, 85, and 86 in `tools/test-driver-loop-strictmode.ps1` when executed under `Set-StrictMode -Version Latest` with specific edge-case initial states (incomplete `$turnResult`, unset `$plannerStatus`/`$fastLaneDone`/`$modeBeforeIncrement`). The test must assert no exceptions are thrown and that the `action-evidence guard` correctly evaluates against the current turn's state, thereby preventing future `StrictMode` leaks and ensuring proper state handling.
constraints: No exceptions (`throw`) must occur during the execution of the specified blocks under the given conditions.
The `action-evidence guard` must evaluate against the *current* turn's state, not a stale one.
Files like `audit-security.ps1:1` must *not* be cleaned or modified.
The test must mock `Read-State` and `Update-State` for isolation.
known_context: Specific blocks 83, 85, and 86 within the script are the focus of the test.
Initial states to test include an incomplete `$turnResult` and unset `$plannerStatus`, `$fastLaneDone`, `$modeBeforeIncrement` (simulating a fresh process).
The `action-evidence guard` is a relevant system mechanism that needs verification.
The new test will be integrated into `smoke.ps1` and triggered by the CI pipeline.
`Read-State` and `Update-State` are state management functions that require mocking for test isolation.
output_format: A pull request containing modifications to `smoke.ps1` (or a new test file included by it) and potentially minor adjustments to `tools/test-driver-loop-strictmode.ps1` if necessary to facilitate testing.
success_tests: A new test case is successfully integrated into `smoke.ps1` (or a file included by it).
The new test case executes blocks 83, 85, and 86 of `tools/test-driver-loop-strictmode.ps1` under `Set-StrictMode -Version Latest`.
The test case initializes the environment with an incomplete `$turnResult` and unset `$plannerStatus`, `$fastLaneDone`, `$modeBeforeIncrement`.
The test case asserts that no exceptions are thrown during the execution of the specified blocks under these conditions.
The test case includes assertions that verify the `action-evidence guard` correctly evaluates against the *current* turn's state, not a stale one, under the specified conditions.
The test case successfully mocks `Read-State` and `Update-State` to ensure isolated execution.
The new test passes when executed as part of the `smoke.ps1` suite.
The new test passes when triggered in the CI pipeline.
